<?php
class QuietNullRead {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): null { echo "G;"; return null; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { global $written; echo "S;"; $written = $value; }
}
function quietNullRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$written = 42;
$receiver = new QuietNullRead;
$selector = "missing";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietNullRhs()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietNullRhs()) === 9 ? "ASSIGN;" : "BAD_ASSIGN;";
echo $written === 9 ? "SET;" : "BAD_SET;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietNullRhs()) === 9 ? "SKIP;" : "BAD_SKIP;";
echo $selector === "missing" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
